notes.basra_quality: Basra census hadar/rif table is arithmetically consistent (2,362,123+546,368=2,908,491); three complete qada sums enter as probable claims.
notes.count_dispute: National qada count: 121 (detailed subdistrict list), 120 (media rounding), 130+ (including post-2013 creations), ~103 (pre-2013 tables). Recorded, never averaged.
notes.disputed_list_entries: الشعب والشعلة (Baghdad) appear in some lists only — unverified; سميل appears under Nineveh in some lists and Dohuk in others — unverified with the affiliation dispute recorded.
notes.no_control_inference: Disputed-territories and de-facto-administration notes (Nineveh plain, مخمور) are recorded as notes, never as control/status inference on the legal frame.
notes.scope: Attested qada inventories for three documented governorates only (Baghdad 14, Nineveh 10, Basra 7); the national qada universe is contested (121 official vs 130+ with post-2013 creations) and stays denominator-open with both readings recorded.
